title: Telecommunications (Dealers) (Amendment) Regulations 2004 (S 48/2004)
kind: the text of the instrument, from the e-Gazette copy (IMDA's list does not include it)
header_as_printed: 1 S 48/2004 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 3rd February 2004 at 5:00 pm. / NO. S 48 / TELECOMMUNICATIONS ACT / (CHAPTER 323) / TELECOMMUNICATIONS / (DEALERS) (AMENDMENT) / REGULATIONS 2004 / In exercise of the powers conferred by section 74 of the / Telecommunications Act, the Info-communications Development / Authority of Singapore, with the approval of the Minister for / Information, Communications and the Arts, hereby makes the / following Regulations: / Citation and commencement
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 3rd February 2004 at 5:00 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch6.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
